result.instructions: Tools for clockin, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Which employees are on absence next week?"; "How many hours did each employee book on project 14 last month?"; "Create a vacation absence for employee 12 from 2 to 6 December, granted.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes clockin data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run clockin_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run clockin_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run clockin_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. clockin_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: clockin_list_employees
tools.title: List employees
tools.description: List employees of the company, paged. Returns id, names, email and related data. Use the ids with the other tools. Customer API: GET /v3/employees.

include.description: One relation to include: department, files, superior, onboardingSecret or customFields.

tools.name: clockin_get_employee
tools.title: Get an employee
tools.description: Get one employee by id. Customer API: GET /v3/employees/{employee}.

include.description: One relation to include: department, files, superior, onboardingSecret or customFields.

tools.name: clockin_search_employees
tools.title: Search employees by last name
tools.description: Find employees whose last name matches exactly. Customer API: POST /v3/employees/search with scope byLastName.

tools.name: clockin_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: List customers of the company, paged. Customer API: GET /v3/customers.

tools.name: clockin_get_customer
tools.title: Get a customer
tools.description: Get one customer by id. Customer API: GET /v3/customers/{customer}.

tools.name: clockin_list_absences
tools.title: List absences
tools.description: List absences (vacation, sick days, workshops and similar), paged. Customer API: GET /v3/absences.

tools.name: clockin_search_absences
tools.title: Search absences
tools.description: Find absences by start time (from this date-time on) and/or approval state. Pass at least one filter. Customer API: POST /v3/absences/search with scopes byStartsAt and byApprovals.

starts_from.description: Only absences that start at or after this ISO 8601 date-time.

tools.name: clockin_get_absence
tools.title: Get an absence
tools.description: Get one absence by id. Customer API: GET /v3/absences/{absence}.

tools.name: clockin_list_projects
tools.title: List projects
tools.description: List projects, paged. Use include=employees,subProjects for the assigned staff and sub-projects. Customer API: GET /v3/projects.

include.description: Comma-separated relations to include, for example employees,subProjects or signedUrl.

tools.name: clockin_get_project
tools.title: Get a project
tools.description: Get one project by id. Customer API: GET /v3/projects/{project}.

include.description: Comma-separated relations to include, for example employees,subProjects or signedUrl.

tools.name: clockin_search_workdays
tools.title: Search workdays
tools.description: Get the work days of employees for a date range. Each day lists its activities (start, end, project_id) and events. Sum activities by project_id for project hours. Customer API: POST /v3/workdays/search.

tools.name: clockin_create_absence
tools.title: Create an absence
tools.description: WRITE: create an absence for one employee. absencecategory_name must match an absence category set up in clockin (for example workshop). approval is denied, granted or pending. Customer API: POST /v3/absences.

absencecategory_name.description: Absence category name set up in clockin.

tools.name: clockin_create_event
tools.title: Create a time event
tools.description: WRITE: record a clock event for one employee, for example a back-dated start of work. task_id: 2 LOADING_TIME, 3 DRIVING_TIME, 4 PROJECT, 5 PAUSE, 6 SPECIAL_1, 7 SPECIAL_2, 8 LOGOUT, 9 BUSINESS_TRIP, 10 WORKING_TIME. Customer API: POST /v3/events.

task_label.description: Custom task label. Only configured label and task id pairs are valid.
